findings.fix: Lead with the non-obvious part only: keep the scope/precedence inventory schema and ancestor-file discovery; drop the generic 'read every relevant file' framing the model already follows.

findings.evidence: If instruction files or repository evidence are unavailable, do not stop at a request for them.
findings.fix: Move this missing-evidence fallback out of the numbered procedure into its own short subsection after step 7; the current long paragraph mixes two scenarios before the workflow starts.

findings.evidence: Claude Code does not automatically load arbitrary files under .claude/; links must say when the agent must read them.
findings.fix: Add the missing harness-precedence gotcha: which file wins when both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md exist and how parent-directory instruction files merge; that is the other landmine in this domain.

findings.evidence: Avoid unnecessary file counts and generic template scaffolding.
findings.fix: Replace with a concrete threshold, e.g. 'create a topic file only when three or more rules share one scope and one read condition'.
